author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.7 - More resilient connection to the thermostat on Hubitat 2.5.1 and newer. The driver now turns on TCP keepalive with a short idle timer, so a connection that quietly dies is detected and re-established within about a minute instead of possibly hanging. This is fully backward compatible: on hubs older than 2.5.1 the connection behaves exactly as it did before — nothing changes for you. (0.19.6 quieted a benign 're-key' warning and delivered the recovery-latch fix that kept a dead connection from retrying; 0.19.5 added the healthStatus online/offline attribute.)
